name: [Item Report] Tabloid
content:
On December 7th, the 677th issue of Sober Daily was secretly taken out of the library. Upon recovery, it was covered in a liquid of unknown origin.
An excerpt from the magazine reads: 
Urban Legends Column
 Dear readers, thank you for your continued support. Today, Leaf will tell you a story about the flower oceans in the center of Bailin City. 
"Back when Bailin was just an unexceptional settlement, people had used flesh and blood to pave the barren land. Shortly after, hundreds upon hundreds of flowers have blossomed there, completely saturating the landscape. 
...
Thats the end of the story. I hope everyone liked it. See you next time."

name: [Item Report] Clay Flowerpot
content: A seemingly ordinary flowerpot containing a single flower. When no wind is present, the flower appears to be swaying happily.

name: Clay Flowerpot - Clue I
content: Produced in a flower ocean on Floor V, by a potter girl whose ceramic house is the only artificial sight in the area.

name: Clay Flowerpot - Clue II
content: When the girl handed him the flowerpot, it felt as if something had been inserted into his heart. \nIn an instant, the girl was torn apart like a thin piece of paper, and all the flowers on the field became erratic and wild, dancing wantonly.

name: [Rec] Under the Dress
content:
Just as he was about to be completely melted into the hellish scenery, the flower field reverted back to its original appearance.
“Is it over? Am I saved?” 
The girl smiled sweetly, and without answering, started picking the hardened eyeballs up from the ground.
Since the time she fell into the flower field, nobody has survived; from now till the end of time, no one will be saved. The body becomes nourishment, and the soul is left twisted, forever wandering. Indifferently witnessing the perishing of every person that comes next.
The sea of flowers contorts the girl's shadow, carefully detects the signs of a soul, and holding the flower pot, guides her towards the next target.

name: Under the Dress - Clue I
content:
As the wind blows over the flower ocean, it creates flower waves. Two people overlooked these movements and smiled at each other.
"We did it.”
"No. You did it." 
The masked man looked at the eyeballs under the girl's skirt. They were ready to move and reach out for him. It seems that he's thinking about whether the man in front of him will be their next companion.
"You are here to pick me up, right?” 
"Correct." 
I don’t know how many years the girl has spent in the flower field, nor do I know how much flesh and blood she has consumed in that time. She gradually grows bigger. Inching towards her destiny.
The masked man took out a glass bottle. She began to drown in it, and scattered into thousands of petals. The petals dyed the water red. The girl showed her visage one last time, gradually sinking, like a leaf that had lost its vitality, leaving only the transparent stem veins. He found her, threw her away, and forgot her. 
"Another one was recovered. Let's see who's left..." 
The masked man opened a file and through it quickly. Almost every page was marked with a large red cross.His fingers stayed, and a faded photo came into his view. It depicted two young girls.They were his next goal.

name: [File] Burn'd Duck
content:
A document found on Alpa's hard drive. 
[On a brightly lit street, the smell of roasted ducks was escaping the constraints of every exhaust fan, permeating the air. Sinking into every piece of clothing, it took control of people as if they were mere puppets, and lead them to the store front.] 
[It was late afternoon, but the outside was already dark and snowy. NceS was sitting in an armchair, with fidgeting with his hands. His right eyelid was twitching uncontrollably, which made him quite worried. He was considering closing the shop for that day.] 
Wuji: You have some customers coming your way. 
NceS: Is that so? Wait, Wuji, what's wrong with your face? How did it change again? 
Wuji: Don't touch it dummy, this new face is far too precious. 
NceS: Ahh, Wuji... You are escaping from someone again, aren't you. Before you ask, I haven't done any illegal smuggling for many years, so don't evem bother. 
Wuji: What? Come on, what could I possibly be running from?
[The man was acquainted with NceS since before he was called Wuji. This time he got in trouble with the administration, and inexplicably decided to visit his ond friend.] 
NceS: What's wrong with you people? I say let the old pigeons scream all over the street. I don't care. But they have covered your food and residence, and your wage will be paid one day. So why would you add bugs to the system? 
Wuji: Ah, so you already know... The old AI was pushed out of the gate. This time, if something goes wrong, they won't get paid, and the entire union will collapse. And when that happens, I will have to make all the charts myself. But just look at my hands! They are covered in bruises blood and sores already! 
NceS: Yeah right! As if I'm gonna believe that! 
Wuji: I don't understand. It's like your attention was always some place elsewhere... 
NceS: Oh, my friend, it was just me playing mahjong with JiangMiTiao and Ctymax over a brain call. 
Wuji: So you always knew? Why didn't you tell them? 
NceS: You know I couldn't do that... Do you want to hide here with us? 
Ash:  I wouldn't mind that!
Wuji: Damn it, they're here! I will drop by again tomorrow! 
NceS: Oh, farewell then. You're welcome at any time. 
TV: Urgent news: The VR cyber virus known as Rubbishphobia, notably spread by a malicious program called "Phigros", is finally under control. Our city's paving expert, Sound Souler, wants to remind the public that Rubbishphobia can be treated by hitting your head against the floor. Repeatedly. 
NceS: What the hell is this-

name: This year on the New Year's Gala
content:
[It is a winter evening at the editorial office of Limbo Wiki. The floor heating is on, with fruits all set in the tray on the table. Geopelia lazily lies on the sofa, staring at the flashing scenes on big TV screen that look like many hypnotic symbols, making her fall asleep. Fuli is setting up the New Year decoration. She stands on the cutting table, with a small lantern in her hand, struggling with the swaying chandelier.] 
Fuli: You little thing wanna fight with me huh? I will let you know wh, who’s in char, charge here……
[Geopelia takes a look at the kitchen, clicks her tongue, and falls back into the sofa.]
Geopelia: Hmmm…… so boring.
Fuli: Come and help me then.
Geopelia: Hmmm…… too lazy to move.
[The TV just happened to show some scenes of koalas. Geopelia suddenly feels like she could be a reincarnation of a koala.]
Fuli: Then make a call and ask Gino and Samuelle. They should have been back for dinner by now.
Geopelia: Hmmm…… it is what it is.
[Looking at the commercials, have a break, have a——]
Fuli: Oh right, you can invite the other friend of you as well. It is more fun with more people here for the festival.
Geopelia: Oh, 
[On a second thought, she finds something not quite right.]
Geopelia: Which friend of mine?
Fuli: The one from Kalpa sub-space. I remembered that she lives in Selene.
Geopelia: You mean Lana? Oh yea, she will be on the New Year's Gala of the Clock City.
Fuli: ???
[Turned to Saturn Channel 1, the guests of the Gala are giving out their new year wishes. Lana is one of them. She has a pair of fake ponytails today and wears a blue and white dress that stands out.]
Host: Is there anything that Miss Lana wants to say to the audience?
Lana: Geopelia! Watch it closely! My transformation!
[Geopelia gives it a cold shoulder and turned of the TV with a swear word.]
Geopelia: See?
Fuli: Nevermind.
Geopelia: Hmmm……
[Geopelia lies back onto the sofa, but then frowns. Lana's outfit looks quite familiar. She might have seen it somewhere.]

name: One less person in the Travelling Squad
content:
[Selene, Jujube fortress region, where Lana lives, a few guests from far away wonders outside the door.]
Elaine: The navigation says it's here.
[The door and windows are closed. No light inside the room. It seems that no one is home.]
Kalpa: Perhaps she's outside. We should wait.
Elaine: The speeds of time flow are different on both sides. Maybe she forgot to go back today.
Kalpa: I don't think so?
Iris: So as we are waiting, do y'all want some freshly baked biscuits?
Elaine&Kalpa: No. 
Iris: Ugh?
[Iris is a bit disappointed. Everyone loves her biscuits in her imagination.]
Elaine: Speaking of biscuits, how's Arcyone doing?
Kalpa: Better now. She got the strength to swear now.
Iris: Arcyone? Oh yea, Arcyone said she would be joining us though.
Kalpa: Don’t you remember Iris? She ate your biscuits before we left. Now she is stilling lying in bed.
Iris: It seems so……
Elaine: Promise me, kid, don't ever put poisonous mushrooms again,
Iris: Wait, the mushrooms are poisonous?
[While the few are speechless to Iris, a young lady with long indigo hair approaches them.]
Igallta: Are you looking for the house owner?
Kalpa: Yes. Do you know where she has gone to?
Igallta: Unfortunately, Lana went to attend the New Year's Gala.
Iris: What is New Year's Gala?
Kalpa: It is a TV show. I've heard of it from Geopelia.
Igallta: Are you friends of Geopelia?
Elaine: She's been to our world.
Kalpa: I remember now. I've seen you in the song.
[Time goes back to 2 weeks ago. On her way to the Sky Dome, she accidentally fell into a sub-space called Kalpa. Because of the law of sub-space, she lost her memories. Kalpa and the Aste and Mero sisters helped her.]
Igallta: In that case, how about we go to Geopelia first? After the end of the show, Lana will be there too.
Kalpa: It won't be any trouble, will it? 
Igallta: Totally not. Fuli said the more people the better. 
Elaine: I guess that's the only way. 
Iris: Wait, Lana really doesn't remember anything?
Kalpa: ......
Elaine: It does seem so.

name: Another me in the world
content:
*: Found a spot, in the middle of the second row.
Yoso: Ho-Ho, I see it! Come here, Nami. The show is about to begin!
Nami: Coming, coming!
[In Clock City Channel Studio 1, three of the audience from a distant world are finally seated before the New Year's Gala begins. Unlike other audience, they are here for a special mission, which will decide if they can safely go home.]
Yoso: Though we came here ASAP upon receiving the message, but what type of Act is the New Year's Gala anyway? The curtain's closed. Can't see anything……
Nami: Well, you’ll know it when the BOSS appears.
*: I remember reading from the book, that the traditional New Year's Gala includes comedy skits, singing and dancing, acrobatics, magic tricks, and other shows, as well as a few news segments.
Yoso: So it’s a composite?
Nami: Well no, Carmen said there is only 1 part to the Act. We can go back to our world after defeating it.
*: Seems that the BOSS is hidden in one of the segments.
Yoso: Wait, the analysis report is out. The scene title is -- ANOTHER ME?
[While the three are discussing, the standard opening chorus has started. The performers are taking the stage while the teleprompter on both sides of the stage show the song titles, including popular hit songs like WATER, 雪降り、メリクリ.]
*: Something's wrong. The data is rising rapidly.
Nami: Is it coming!
[The lights dim, and the cogs turn. As the high voice of the female singer begins, something bizarre happened. The singer on stage has a high resemblance of Yoso.]
Yoso: Is she…
[On stage, Lana looks into the audience. The blue-haired girl wearing headphone is staring at her. But Lana does not stop. She needs to go to the polyphonic track next. A cosplay fan? So she has fans in PhigrOS now.]
Yoso: Wait!
[With that, she chased after her.]

name: Family and friends gather together
content:
Igallta: Long time no see.
Fuli: Yo, it's been a long time.
Geopelia: You just video called yesterday.
Igallta: [Laugh] That's true.
Fuli: Hey don't blow it.
[Since Ark Mirage, Fuli and Igallta have been together a lot. Seems that they've become good friends.]
Fuli: They are?
Geopelia: This is Kalpa. And two of the Twelve Palace guardians. Should be.
[Should be?]
Fuli: Are you here to pick up Lana?
Kalpa: As you said.
Fuli: All right then. Come in.
Iris: Me is Iris. You want some biscuits? We already made some, but there was a little problem…… I can make them on the spot!
Elaine: I'm Elaine, the temporary supervisor of this kid.
Iris: Iris is also a guardian. Iris doesn’t need a supervisor.
.Elaine: All right all right, here's some mandarin orange. Open your mouth.
Iris: Ah~
[Are they here to do comedy?]
Geopelia: Lana is in charge of the second channel. Might only come after 1 or 2 am.
Fuli: No rush. Here's the deal. We can all stay for the New Year's Eve dinner. If there's not enough food, I can ask Gino to bring back some more.
Gino: Unfortunately, I'm already back.
[The familiar figure with a slightly embarrassed smile. I pulled out my phone and dialled the number of a fellow bird.] 
Naberius: No cash, no insurance, and not available for mah-jong.
Geopelia: It's me, Dr Crow.
Naberius: Oh, it's you, Coo-coo. We will be there in a minute.
Geopelia: We have an emergency. Bring some code dishes.
Naberius: Okok. Then five-spiced beef, boiled chicken slices, beef and beef offal, multi-flavoured jelly fish, preserved eggs with sauce, chicken feet with pickled peppers, are these enough? If not, hey, Samuelle what are you doing --
[Noises of quarrelling and fighting for the phone.]
Samuelle: Whims? Three of them? Suggest eliminating.Geopelia: Nope, they are guests.
Samuelle: Tsk, not fun.
Naberius: Ok so what I was saying --
Geopelia: That's enough. Just come back.

name: Future falls down to me
content:
Lana: Welcome everyone to the channel! I'm back again~
Lana: Yah, Lana didn't expect to be invited by the New Year's Gala either. I'm just a gamer anyway
Lana: Ask actors to go there and sing is a Gala tradition? Who says I'm a faking actor? Don’t try to mess with me ok. Hey mod! Do something, mod!
[While Lana is arguing with the viewers, the door of the streaming studio opens. The specialist named Yoso quietly moves behind Lana with her mission. Taking in a deep breath, she announces her arrival.]
Yoso: Surrender now! ANOTHER ME!
Lana: !!!
[The tin guitar smashes. Lana makes a sharp dodge to her left and kicks the ground with her right foot. Holding onto the back of the chair, she spins one and a half round and lands gracefully. In a split second, Lana's chance to win the fight sharply rises, making Yoso, who is further away from the door, greatly disadvantaged instead.]
Lana: Who on earth are you! You can hate me for your unrequited love, but gosh don't make it physical please!
Yoso: Nonsense. I'm here to finish you off!
[Everyone in the editorial office, plus all the viewers, are watching this right now.]
Samuelle: Whims again. You want me to catch it for research?
Naberius: Wait, I might have seen that trouble making girl before.
Geopelia: [Sudden realization] Isn't her the heroine of the new release of Pigeon Games? No wonder I find it familiar.
Fuli: [Emotionlessly] Ah right – That game studio, who took the portrait rights of the editorial office yet doing no legitimate work, is making a new game.
Gino: They just only made the Phigros prototype. Do they even have enough time for the new project?
Geopelia: No idea. But the theme song for Coo-coo is ready. Heh.
Kalpa: It's no good to just let them fight right?
Iris: There's a weak point on the left! Attack the left!
Igallta: It's really no good. Just bring them here, Samuelle.
Samuelle: Tsk, what a trouble.
[Despite saying that, Samuelle still walks up to the TV, clenches her fits, then slightly opens them, puts her fingers into the screen. The surrounding air vibrates at a high frequency, making a continuous deep drum noise.]
Kalpa: Is she manipulating space?
Iris: Sounds very impressive.
[The two from the other side of the screen feel something is wrong, as if an invisible force locking up their limbs, pulling them to the unknown faraway.]
Lana: This feeling, could it be!
Yoso: New mechanism?
[Yoso wants to change speciality. The lit-up bracelet terminal catches her attention. She uses up all the strength on her wrist to barely boot it up.]
Carmen: Desire value recognition anomaly detected this morning. Not any Act on the show confirmed. Mission aborted. Please return to the base ASAP.
Yoso: ???
Lana: I saw all of it, the message just now.
Yoso: Ahem, there might be some misunderstanding between us.
Lana: I want my mental damage compensation! Half a million, no, 1 million!
Yoso: Chill! We can talk.
Samuelle: Need me to call the cops?
[The moment Yoso speaks, scenes before her eyes twist and turn like a kaleidoscope. At that moment, her thoughts go back to the pure white room of the beginning of birth. Countless possibilities and fear rise up her mind. She seems to have forgotten something important. Not just travelling with *, with the rest, and more.]
Samuelle: Wake up.
Yoso: Ah.
Samuelle: It's over, all the struggles.
Yoso: You know my --
Samuelle: No I don't. But you will remember.
[Samuelle is a mystery. A forever unsolvable mystery.]
Lana: Stop chatting over there. Where is my compensation!
Kalpa: I know you, Lana. You don't really want the compensation.
Elaine: You're just angry. Nothing wrong with it.
Iris: Lana is the cutest for not being frank! 
Lana: [Blushes] I, I’m not that.
Yoso: Sorry, my bad! I was too eager to go back to my original world and I lost my cool!
Lana: You are making me embarrassed now…… All right, I forgive you.
Yoso: I'm so touched!
Elaine: What a coincidence. We are not residents of Phigros either.
Yoso: Is that so?
Geopelia: Well, Phigros has been pierced like a sieve.[People from the Phigros side really want to roast it but they held up.]
Iris: Kalpa, help her out.
Kalpa: I'm sorry, but I can only travel to other worlds by coordinates. I think Miss Samuelle should have a way though.Samuelle: Not now. You will go back. I promise.
Yoso: [Upset] I guess we have to trust Miss Samuelle for now.
Fuli: Never mind all of those! The dishes are ready! Let’s have dinner!
Geopelia: The New Year's Eve dinner! Yay!
Iris: [Stands up] Kalpa! This chicken is soooo delicious! Better that the ones I cooked! Elaine you should try it too!
Elaine: Sit down first. You are getting the sauce onto your clothes.
Fuli: Try this. The wiki says, if you chew for 50 times, it will taste like petrol.
Igallta: Though AI has not been using petrol fuel for a long time, but still I appreciate your kindness.
Geopelia: Why I can't turn on the TV? Hey Samuelle, your power does not consume one TV every time you use it, does it?
Samuelle: You are thinking too much. Just eat.
Naberius: The TV is fine. The streaming media signal is gone.
Geopelia: Oh yea, Lana you should go back to your live stream. Stop eating.
Lana: What's wrong with you?
Gino: Just change a channel. [Takes the remote, and presses some buttons] There you go.
Geopelia: That makes sense.
[And so, everyone welcomes the new year in happiness and laughter.]

name: Decryption – The Last Notalium
content:
"Still haven't found it yet?"
"Wrong key?"
Lanota, a subspace born from memories, carrying the shared memories of rhythm game players, has survived for centuries since it first docked at the Harbour, and has finally reached the beginning of the story.
In their quest to retrieve the world of colour, Fisica and Ritmo embarked on a journey. They first met Rossa and Nero from the Silence Border Guard, and then tracked down by Director Halpas - Geopelia chattered nonstop on the way here, trying to get Gino to understand the story of Lanota.
Ever since Ark Mirage, Gino has been active as a private detective, while Geopelia focused on tidying up the "Legacy". She rarely leaves her place in the Vault, but this was an exception.
A blonde woman approached them, and hope that they could go to the world of Lanota to help her retrieve the loss, and the key to unlocking the subspace is:
A piece of Notalium which won't trigger Al Niente. This is the only one. As for the way to enter, please explore on your own."
Gino initially did not want to take on this kind of "find my lost cat" type of job, but the sincere pleading eyes of the rhythm game player Geopelia made him hesitate. The client caught that opportunity, left the token here and disappeared into nowhere.
Year 771, May. In the remaining ruins of the Harbour layer, Geopelia strolled around the broken stones and debris while holding the red Notalium. Gino and she had been wandering around the designated area for the whole morning, and there was no reaction from the token at all. "Lanota has yet to reveal its mystery to them.
Gino looked down in deep thought, lines of texts flashed in front of his eyes. He was reviewing the client request letter. They must have missed something important.
Faraway, Mazarine was engulfing the edges of the layer. The once ginormous city complex has now only left with the capital, like a lonely isle in the river. The buildings were continuously relocating. They walked in front of the Newknot Sculpture Square. Their marble and steel structure looked like a monotone photographic film.
Hey, is that Ritmo's lute?" Geopelia pointed towards the debris not far away.
"Could it be a way in?" Gino wondered.
As the subspace evolved, it is possible to influence the main layer.
Try playing it, Gino! It looks promising! Geopelia looked at the glowing Notalium, then back to Gino.
Gino sighed. He sat on the stone stair, with his left hand he fumbled with the intervals. After slight tuning, he played the piece mentioned by the client.
Apocalypse.
The Notalium glowed brightly, floated into the air, and create a stone door that reads:
"He who enters this door, shall regain all melody."
Gino and Geopelia looked at each other, and made the decision.

HINT: Complete Protoflicker IN difficulty, with ACC greater than 95%.

name: Decryption – Half A Letter
content:
They arrived at the tunnel of the National Institute of Notalium. One of the duties of the Silence Border Guard was to find the end of the tunnel.
The Notalium weapon, Apocalypse, has already been activated. A line of text slowly displayed on the surface of the device, "A Niente 95%". Geopelia immediately realised, that they had already missed the very beginning of the story.
Geopelia said anxiously, "Let's go to the Aircraft. Maybe we can still stop Ritmo and the others."
"No worries, they'll be fine. Let's go to the institute first and get the stuff the client wants."
It was only then that the player minded Geopelia remembered that the client had mentioned the whereabouts of the missing item. She summoned the adult Alpa, a black tiger 2 metres in size with a sharp gaze. With its breaths, a black mist filled all directions around, and within moments the location of the institute is discovered.
Upon arrival, Alpa used the old trick and found the item in a room full of clocks and objects with marks from the main layer. It was a letter written in a self-made language. Only the first half of it, while the second half was nowhere to be found.
"Meow~" After completing its tasks, Alpa jumped straight into Geopelia's arms, still clinging to her as if it were a child.As for why a tiger meows, that's a question for Coo-coo." I remember Fisica picking up an unreadable document. Could it be that?" Geopelia added.
"Possible. So to the Administration headquarter?" Gino looked toward Alpa.
Alpa gazed at the northern horizon. After a while, it seemed to have locked on to the target.

HINT: Complete Horizon Blue on any difficulty with a total of 0 miss and bad.

name: [Decipher] Golem
content:
They flew on their motorbike to the Notalium Administration headquarter, finding only debris and ruins.
"The fight is already over." Gino sighed.
Kicking the mechanical golem who had lost its vitality, Geopelia looked at Gino bitter, as if she had missed something worth a billion.
"Don't think about it. Even if we caught it, they won't be dancing to Horizon Blue's beat as they fight."
"Not necessarily. We're in the Pixel Tower. Here anything's possible."
As soon as Geopelia's words left her mouth, the Notalium on the golem's chest lit up and came back to life. It danced a bizarre move as the parasitic purplish-black vines quickly grew out and came towards them.
"Ms Goo Goo, your prediction just came true."
"No, Mr. DJ you dropped the wrong beat. I didn't ask for You are the miserable."
"Does it matter?"
"It matters for Coo-coo!"

HINT: Complete You are the miserable AT difficulty with a total score above 820000.

name: [Decipher] The Client
content:
A whim that was given life casually usually has limited power. The two didn't take long to end the fight, while Alpa had yet to detect their previously locked target.
The dazzling golden organ had somehow materialised, with heaven and earth as its hall, and its music loud enough to resonate in all directions. The two sat side by side on the piano bench, playing Igallta together, not You are the miserable.
"Mr. Detective, trust me, I didn't choose it. I would have chosen the one that merges." Geopelia was still trying to explain.
"It wasn't me either. You know me, Ms Coo-coo. I would have chosen Rrhar'il."
"A tune never heard before......"
"Well, just came up with it." Gino was thinking about how to move the organ. It would be bad if someone else saw it."A hound? Coo-coo - it feels like -"
She examined the organ's windpipe as if she had spotted something and suddenly stood up, "Something's wrong. Lanota is a naturally occurring memory typed subspace. No one can enter except during periods of concentrated whimify. How could the client lose items in a closed state subspace…"
Gino's eyes shifted as he realised, "Unless-"

HINT: Complete Stasis AT difficulty with a total score above 700000.

name: Sound of Life
content:
Mother of Notalium, Ena, wife of Director Halpas, entrusted others to establish the Silence Border Guard before she passed away. 
"Notalium must be destroyed." It was their only principle. 
But, could this be the end of the story.
The organisation is looking for the end of the tunnel, and there are only two things at the end - a pipe organ with the words "Ena, wait for me" written on it, and an airship that flies to the headquarter of the Notalium Administration.
Is this all a coincidence.
"The flower language of the forget-me-not is 'hope'."
The chime rings, and nature has its own rhythm. Under the apple tree, the boys set off for the "outside world". The bard plays the tune of midnight, rubbing the disc to bring back a heart full of colours.
At the end of the story, is there the peace of Notalium's disappearance.
I hope not.
Agilely, she climbs up the branches of the giant tree to pick a ripe fruit, with its sweet flesh and solid core beneath its reddish skin. It really does take a veteran detective to find what she lost.
"Have you found it?"
"Found it."

To the client - for you who love Lanota

name: Stave No.0
content:
(Excerpt from a Phigros Project)

For once you were a wandering organism,
With no religion, yet received a baptism.

Like white vines on a holy stone atop the firmament,
With the order the sword was drawn out of sheath.

How I wish the ice would be scattered by an axe from the heavens,
And hunger would no longer haunt the abyss.

the child listened, thought and sighed,
"Build a tower to challenge the sky."

name: Stave No.1
content:
Escape.

Now that the rainbow fades,
Where,
Where else might it stay?
Where there be
Fragrance inside the posies,
Echoes beneath the memories,
Spirits from the awakened,
Dreams above the illusions,
There be my home.

name: Stave No.2
content:
Glaciaxia, melting.

Chasing the sun went the birds o' gods,
Beneath the poem shone the lights and howls.
A bird summoned by the spring,
A sword glittered for the win.
Met at the summit, chased with the winds,
Down fell the feathers, in rain they rinsed.
A tongue that twisted, two shadows there stood,
The firmament above touched the recital at foot.
Listen, Mount Sierra, coiled by the wind -
What was she saying?
Why was she crying?
The floods unleashed mercy to no being,
The milk spilt needed no regretting.
Should we rest, may we wait,
Not too far the chance awaits.

name: Stave No.3
content:
Coo, coo, coo,
Bubble, bubble, bubble.

Fine fish skin with boiled white apple, take a sip and let your spirits free.
A string twanged as a spur of the moment, wonder why someone would become addict.
For decades long there was no music but the sound of death near the river. Please just stay at my humble house, and detail what wind blew you here.

name: Stave No.4
content:
Do people's identities really hold any value…

Whoever lives owns a name,
Whoever dies owns a name.
For fame beings live,
For what the dead prolong?
Would they, if ever, be reborn?

name: Stave No.5
content: Unable to learn how to write poetry…\n\nSpring, the elusive season of recovery.

name: Stave No.6
content:
Hikari.

Here we are in the age of exile,
Shall irises bloom, and may mist die,
Lacerated by shafts of light,
Seeking path through the hazy sky.

name: [Item] The Alpa Pen
content: A pure white recording pen belonging to Geopelia. It has a mope sticker on the right, along with the names "Geopelia" and "Peregrinus" carved on the back.\nThe pen is equipped with an AI assistant called MeowAlpa, which records everything she writes. Although it does not have a consciousness, it occasionally produces strange noises, seemingly without cause.

name: The Alpa Pen - Clue I
content:
Geopelia uses it to record what she hears, as well as any ideas that pop into her head. Over time Alpa has gathered a rich collection of often embarrasing, dark, or even incomprehensible meoms.
Gino: What do you even keep in this pen?
Geopelia: My brother told me that secrets can only be shared with close friends.  Are you my close friend?
Gino: Hmm… Hard to say. What do you think?
Geopelia: Well, he also told me that friends won't pry into others' secrets. Soo, I guess you aren't!
Gino: Ah, I see your brother is truly a master of logic.
Geopelia: He sure is!

name: The Alpa Pen - Clue II
content:
Geopelia has received the pen on her 10th birthday, and it has been her most treasured possession ever since.
: A bit further… Aghhh!
[A heavy object drops to the floor]
: Geez, are you alright man?
: I'm fine, it's just a scratch. I'll take care of it.
[Peregrinus turned on the tap. The sink reflects the image of Alpa, sound asleep.]
: I'm almost… there…

name: The Alpa Pen - Clue III
content:
MeowAlpa was a college graduation project made by Geopelia's brother. Alpa's intelligence is a bit higher than an ordinary cat's, but it is still able to record, categorize, play back and change the format of anything Geopelia writes. Sometimes it leaves the pen, as a holographic cat.
Geopelia: Alpa is soo quiet today...
Gino: It's probably sleeping. It's in standby, after all. Hey, you, newbie! Hurry up and finish the report, we want to go.
Geopelia: Oh! What's for dinner?
Gino: Not biscuits.
Geopelia: Roger that!

name: [Rec] Mountain Breeze
content: The audio records abnormal wuthering winds across the Wells. The howls and whistles echo through the walls, like the growls of otherwordly beasts.\nThe long, and high-pitched sound stopped after a few minutes, only to make way for a tide of stronger sounds, reverberating and bouncing around the well.  Whispers cascade down, lamenting the icy doomsday,  accompanied by the wind's whistles, creating a twisted symphony –\n- Someone broke through the door, and the recording  stopped abruptly.

name: [Item] Team VII Badge
content: The proof of Geopelia's Team VII membership. It depicts an anemone blooming on a snowy field.

name: [Rec] Hot Pot
content: "Inside the steaming copper hotpot, fine slices of fresh salmon are spinning in the oily broth.\nThe shiny, grey skin outlines the fillets, while green onion and coriander swirl and dance around them.\nAs the tongue touches the crisp, rich fish, it sizzles and melts inside the mouth, warms up the body, and frees the soul from the chilly weather outside. With every spoonful, the heart becomes warmer, as all worries melt away."

name: [Rec] Sleep
content:
The light was still lit.
I opened the window.
The moon was swimming through the clouds,
the firmament was dyed with slashes of meteors.
The wind was coming from the distant tower, twisted and swirled into my cabin.
The icy weather made me shiver, so I had no choice but to close the windows and crawl back into my warm quilt.
I turned my desktop on and began playing my recordings from the past, pen in hand.
Never was a single word written. Given up on the work, I gazed out of the window again -
there seemed to be something different beyond the mist.
There was a tower - or maybe not, as it was too big to see its end, too tall to find its top. Wearing the clouds, it seemed to be accompanied with flying creatures - or more like whales - looking at my world from the heights.
"How could there be such a tower...
It didn't exist yesterday."

name: [Rec] Sleep - Clue I
content:
Listening to Gino's even breathing, I can't help but follow the rhythm -
One, two, one, two...
So gentle and calm, comforting and reassuring.
"You still awake?"
The rhythm stopped abruptly. Has he awkoen?
"Haven't I told you to… not to stay up too late..."
Gino shook the bed frame, making it squeak slightly.
I pushed on it, the noise stopped.
Ahh~~ So... Sleepy... 
 I'll just rest for now, there is always tomorrow.
And so today's diary ends here. Nighty night.

name: [Rec] Snow
content: The white floc is soft and gentle, almost resembling cotton candy. Floating on the other side of the mountain, emitting the sounds of creeking foam when stepped on. it seems to have no use other than depriving the body of warmth. Gino told us that it's called "snow". It's been a long time since the vast glaciers have last dawned this mellow soft coating.  The beautiful sight wasn't the only positive. Snow means clouds. Clouds mean water. Water means that the climate is actually warming up. Perhaps in the future, the icy lakes will run once again, and the fish will leave the lowest parts of the water and multiply near the surface.\n"The Fish Festival will arrive in half a month. You'll love it."

name: [Item] Trophon
content: Gino's treasured amphibious motor. It is capable of traversing various enviroments, thanks to Captain Dlyro's modifications. It has gliding boards for snowy terrain, but can retract them and transform into a powerful land motor, with only a press of a button.

name: Trophon - Clue I
content:
Geopelia is on really good terms with the captain, which often arouses the other teammates' envy.
Carl: Cap seems to like the new girl a lot...
Theo: I guess you're right, haven't really noticed it before. Maybe because she's cute?
Carl: Oh, so you think she's cute?
Theo: [visibly embarrassed] N… No, that's nonsense!
Carl: Come on man, everyone knows you have a thing for her. You should discuss that with the captain at the festival.
Theo: I...
(Theo quickly glanced at Dlyro who was chatting with the tea and seemed to be in good mood. Theo thought to himself for a long time, and seemed to have made up his mind.)

name: Trophon - Clue II
content: A special coded pattern on Trophon's side allows members of the patrol to identify Gino easily. When he first joined the patrol, he spent a lot of time on fine tuning the design. His efforts were successful, as nobody outside of the partol team has ever been able to crack it.

name: Trophon - Clue III
content: During the escape, Trophon's rear-view mirrors were swallowed by the black vortex.

name: [Item] Airdrop Biscuits
supervisor: The Patrol Team VII Warehouse / Geopelia
content: Extremely unpalatable compressed biscuits. They are airdropped into the patrol camp on a weekly basis. They seem to not appear on the official supply reports... And also sometimes come with chili sauce, that's said to replenish vitamin C very effectively.

name: [Item] Ancient Flute
content:
The only non-electronic musical instrument in Glaciaxia. Due to its complexity and minimal wear, it is considered the most prided treasure in Gino's hometown.
Geopelia: Wait, you brought this thing from your home "town"? Aren't you from the glaciers?
Gino: It's not a town, just a regular patrol encampment. But the flute did make it at least somewhat special. Having a unique relic from before the Frozen Age, especially one this well preserved... It must be about 700 years old, and it still looks new...
Geopelia: Since it's so valuable, how could you bring it out?
Gino: The master said that if the flute wasn't nourished with emotions and melodies, it would melt into the glacier, and disappear like so many other instruments. Erraneous as that is, I still promised to practice it from time to time, out of respect for him. He did think it was the only way to truly protect it...
Geopelia: Oh, really?

name: [Rec] Orioles
content: The virtual yellow flames flickered gently in the fireplace as the musician took his flute out of its case and said, “Here’s a melody I wrote for you to celebrate this happy day."\nHe then played the song without any lyrics that somehow still conveyed a clear meaning. It's as if the flute itself was singing about orioles, the symbol of happiness, waking up with spring just around the corner. Dreaming of melting the endless glaciers, of the world once more coming to life after the winter, of the snow desert evaporating once and for all. Forever longing for the days when creeks were free to run as they please, when the flowers were innocent, and the world was more than pits and flying platforms. Days long gone, almost entirely forgotten, the flute being one of their only reminders not buried under tons of ice.

name: [Item] Dorm Key
content:
Key to the Team VII dormitory in which Geopelia and Gino reside. Geopelia usually keeps it inside her hat, to avoid losing it.
Gino: Geopelia, unlock the door already! I need to get my shower things.
Geopelia: The user you are trying to reach is currently busy. Please call again later.
[Suddenly there was a loud bang, as if something heavy had been dropped, followed by some muffled groans.]
Gino: It definitely doesn't sound like you're changing, you cuckoo!
Geopelia: I'm not a cuckoo!
[Geopelia opened the door, wearing nothing but a plain shirt. She looked around to make sure no other team members were nearby, and threw a pile of clothes at Gino.]
Geopelia: Go take your shower, and don't even dare to come back before 10!
Gino: Wait, were you snooping through my closet? [He looks closer, only to realize that the shirt she was wearing was part of his uniform.]
Geopelia: Hmph. A cuckoo wouldn't be interested in your smelly rags!
[Geopelia slammed the door shut, causing a gust of wind that made Gino squint.]

name: [Item] Demice Horn
content: Demices that come out of their abyss-like wells are often hunted, as their bodies are full of valuable materials. Their horns are the most widely sought after, as they are crucial in the creation of many items, both as a tool and an ingredient. They can even be polished enough to create crystal bags, used to contain large amounts of fish.

name: [Item] Electromagnetic Shotgun
content: Team VII's flagship weapon. Its arching barrel design is beloved by many team members.

name: [Item] Fish Basket
content: Geopelia's dedicated fish basket that she aquired during the previous Fish Festival. Made from a Demice's ribcage, it is very sturdy, completely water resistant, and relatively lightweight. Obtaining the necessary materials for the accessory's creation is obviously dangerous, but people still do it, as the baskets are a necessity during the great hunt.

name: [Rec] Fish Show
content:
Baits are set, hooks are tight, fishermen are standing by.
In no time, the sharp twisted forks alight, the sounds of splashing.
The river ice was dyed with the color of the strong conquering the weak. Bloody red.
If the hunt is the nature's gift to mankind, what is it for the prey?
Is it an inescapable fate, or a disaster that cannot be predicted?

name: [Item] Strand of Hair
content: Virtually the only proof of Theo's existance before being taken away by a demice. It was handed to Captain Dlyro by Carl, who was Theo's partner, and witnessed his death.\n"Run… before… it's too late… They… They're coming… the well…"

name: [Rec] The Black Vortex
content: A ditch of forever stagnant water, where no breeze can create ripples. \nHard as you search in the pile of waste, a new world cannot be created.\n"Alpa Recording: Today is the last day of march, and the glaciers met a huge disaster. Ashes from the tower lit every stationed person on fire, a the abyss swallowed the entire horizon, sucking up all light. We rushed towards Mount Sierra, Dlyro that this is the only path protected by the tower."

name: [Image] Dark Bile
content: During the motorbike escape, Geopelia took some strange photos. Some of them depict what seem to be dark balls of fat coming out of people's bodies, leaving behind irregular marks on the snow. As grotesque and surreal as the sight was, when looking at the pictures, Geopelia felt a certain sense of familiarity.

name: [Item] Silk Pouch
content: Dlyro gave Gino this purse, inside which were a chip and piece of fabric with a simple order.\n"Go to the place where you first met Geopelia."

name: [Item] Patient Uniform
content: In Findstr's opinion, it’s one of the worst-designed uniforms he'd ever seen. It was quickly discarded and thrown away when he had recieved his patrol uniform.  He didn't even mind it being previously owned.

name: [Item] Flowery Knife
content:
When Ash woke up, he found himself lying on the snow desert, with a decorated knife in his hand. He would use this knife when cooking with his wife, before he had met Findstr.
Findstr: I think I understood your predicament.
Ash: Wait, really?
Findstr: Yup. You just need to follow me.

name: [Image] Deep Well
content: On the fifth day of their aimless journey across the glaciers, the two encountered a large number of demices. If it weren't for the steep cliffs under which they had hidden themselves, they would have been ripped to shreds. Everything on the strange foreign, surface turned still, and Ash finally had a moment to rest. On his head a an iron helmet, beneath his feet an endless abyss. He looked around to find a way out, but the light couldn't slice the darkness. Only a pond at the bottom of the abyss reflected his face. It looked just like the Well he used to reside in. He suddenly seemed to be able to make out the surroundings of his old home in the darkness, even if they were just his memories. The only way he could tell it wasn't his Well was the size. What he knew was cramped, warm, and almost suffocating. This one was so enormous that a soul could wander it for eternity.\n"I found a way out."

name: [Rec] Hikari
content: As the legend goes, when enough star particles light up in the exosphere, they shall form a beautiful arc. When countless fragments pour down in unison, they will become a door of light, bringing insight from faraway realms. If you happen to become the first to cross that gate, you will be greeted with a new world.\n"Let's go, Gino..."\n"To forge infinite light in the everlasting darkness."

name: [Login Permissions] Saturn
content: Limbo communication permissions. Before being sucked into the black vortex, Captain Dlyro threw a pouch containing them in Gino's direction.

name: Saturn Login - Clue I
content:
At night, patrol members that weren't on shift were chatting in the comms room, with Captain Gino sitting on the sofa, alone. Dlyro suddenly turned back towards Gino and asked:
Dlyro: Is this whole world even real?
Gino: Pardon, ma'am?
Dlyro: I know this may be a bit hard to process, but haven't you noticed?
Dlyro: All the information, legends, music, traditions of the past, should have died during the small ice age. And yet, they still exist in our memories, seven hundred years later. Don't you ever wonder where they all came from?
Gino: I don't think I can answer that…
[Gino wasn't able sleep that night.]

name: Suppression Order 0327
content: In order to deal with the gigantic outburst of demices from the abyss, the elites ordered various patrol teams to initiate  encirclement and suppression activities.  as soon as Dlyro received the mission. However, Gino and Geopelia were not appointed.

name: Demice Skin Paper 377
content: Skin of a glacier demice, covered in illegible writing. Geopelia was only able to make out the numbers 377. She handed the rest of the page to Alpa for further analysis.

name: Demice Skin Paper 377 - Clue I
content: [Analysis Progress: 3%]\n[Words identified: Tower / Puppet / Awaken]

name: Glaci'o'Food
content:
Famous gourmet magazine distributed in the upper echelons of Glaciaxia. Its editor-in-chief is, according to Dlyro, an interesting experimental chef, who also used to lead the No.1 Circuit Rescue Team. Because subscribing to the e-magazine for a full year rewards the subscriber with 5 liters of ungulate oil, Dlyro used his subordinates' accounts to purchase 10 subscriptions of Glaci'o'Food, as it was much cheaper than ordering ungulate oil by itself.
Geopelia: Gino, have you noticed -
Gino: Noticed what?
Geopelia: Every time the magazine organizes a lottery, you're always on the list.
Gino: How the - How can I win if I haven't even signed up for anything?
Geopelia: Just look.

name: Glaci'o'Food - Clue I
content:
Glaci'o'Food No.88's Cover: Peppered Camel Mince
"The dish was inspired from a discovery during an expedition. We found an enormous amount of tier-1 whimified bush near the resting place of camels at camp 47. According to the documents, these types of semi-ligneous plants, with alternate, simple leaves, should be pod peppers, an extinct vegetable. It's now being revived by whimification. I recalled that once my old master told me, during ancient times, pepper and salt are best additives to make dishes. Rediscovering the pepper ignites my spirit to recover the ancient recipe. During the nighttime break, I bought a camel from a local camel hunter and experimented my dish. It was a tastebud-buster. Sliced pepper wove perfectly into the minced camel meat. Next, I added some peppercorn and rosemary and decorated the dish. And that's the cover dish of the month."
As usual, we'll pick 5 lucky readers and present you our cover dish. Their names can be found on the back of the magazine.
According to "the back of the magazine": "Congratulations to Gino! Your dish would be served within 3 days, delivered to your camp."
Geopelia: See? I pick at random.
Gino: Yea, I know this. It's the only time that I received the prize.
Geopelia: So lucky me? Let's just browse through the backs of these magazine.
Geopelia: Gino, Gino, Gino, Gino… Wait, what's this?

name: Glaci'o'Food - Clue II
content:
Glaci'o'Food No.93's Cover: Garlic Ape Eyes
"In theory, whims should be brining disasters to the world, and thus should be eliminated. However, ape, a useless species of whim, is not hostile to us. When I say useless, I mean apes aren't doing anything good for us either. They're usually seen lying on the river bank, with little amount of meat that could be eaten. If they were not tier-3 whimified, they should not be on the elimination list. When the editors received a cuisine that uses ape as its main ingredient, they're quite shocked. But when they scrolled down and found that the cuisine is actually made by ape eyes, they turned their shock to praises. The idea of the dish came from the suppression act against the ghast tide days ago, when the chef of the dish was clearing the battlefield near the river. He stopped his steps at a branch of the river, where he found hundreds of apes dead on a layer of ice. The river bank has marks of wolf claws, and rumors are that such a soil may have garlic grown beneath. The chef managed to harvest several garlics, which were then blended with apes' eyes to create this delicious cuisine. Tip, with a slight hint of vinegar, the dish would taste even better."
The back of the magazine reads: Congratulations to our lucky reader Gino! Your dish would be served within 5 days, delivered to your camp.
Gino: ???
Geoopelia: Ha, eyes.
Gino: I have no appetite for those nasty eyes. I didn't eat that.
Geopelia: It's said that all whims have glittering eyes. Are the apes' eyes shiny?
[Gino looked at Dlyro's collection desk, in the middle of which was a glittering specimen of an eyeball.]
Gino: I think there must be something about this issue.

name: Glaci'o'Food - Clue III
content:
Glaci'o'Food No.45's Cover: Grilled Mule Tongue
"Today, when the techniques to tame and control a ghast horse is at the edge of being lost, it's our pleasure and luck to interview the last hero with the ability of "Inter-action", Dlyro. She's also the leader of Team VII."
[Video Clip] * Dlyro is displaying the skill of commanding a ghast horse.
[Alert: File incomplete. Attempting to fix…]
[Alert: File corrupted.]
[File rollback and resetting completed.]
Dlyro mentioned grilled donkey, a famous cuisine that only existed in ancient recipes. The mules found this time near the camp of Team LXXXI should be a crossbreed of donkey and horse, which could replace the donkey meat in that recipe. Their outrageous speed of reproduction lit the urge of Dlyro to make full use of their meat. Dlyro also mentioned that the essence of mule meat is its tongue, and that's how the dish was invented.
More than half of our staff came from Team LXXXI. In fact we all believe Glaci'o'Food literally originate from the patrol team. In order to express our gratitude to Dlyro's cuisines and hands-on help, we decided to reserve a seat for lucky reader every month for Team VII, and present him/her a monthly-featured cover cuisine.
Geopelia: Well, the mystery seems to be solved.
Gino: Yea, and shall we head for lunch right now?
[Something flashed into Geopelia's mind]
Geopelia: Hey, the magazine updates today!
Gino: I've a bad feeling about it.

name: Rewind
content: Do you truly understand Phigros?

name: D.O.M.E.
content:
Looking down over the Sky Dome layer, dense networks of rivers crisscross the iron-gray land like oil draining across a dry riverbed, syrup spilling over cracked earth. The land is where fallen leaves return and dust turns to soil; the rivers are starry streams of a dreamlike Milky Way.


 [Motorcycle rumbling] [Grass rustling]
 [A cooing alarm]
 ????????: What's happening?!
 ????: [Brakes] That's the car's malfunction warning. Huh? [Fabric rustling] Hey, don't wander off!
 Geopelia: Maybe it got jostled on the way here. Let me see - oh no, Gino, even Coo-coo has never seen this error!
 Gino: [Hold] Sit back down first! [Tapping panel] [Sound of loading failure] No good, can’t fix it out here.


 Geopelia: Then... do we go home first?
 Gino: That’s our only option. [Bending down] [Turning the throttle] Hold on tight; the shortcut's going to be rough.
 Trophon's engine roared like thunder, shattering the stillness of the place.
 Geopelia: Whoa---
 

It was hard to tell how long it had been since the two reunited. Every possible points of reference in this place had lost their validity, making estimations of time impossible for them.
 Whether it was because of the Mazarine End or not, the Vault had changed considerably. Fortunately, they had left their motorcycle here earlier; otherwise, who knows how long their patrol would’ve taken.
Geopelia: [Squinting] Ugh, that road was so dusty! [Eyes open] Oh, we're here.
 Not far ahead was their little cabin.
 Gino: Yeah, we made it back before it completely died.
 [Engine dying sound]
 Gino: Sigh...
 Geopelia: Don't sigh like that, little Gino.
 Geopelia: [Tilting her head, thinking]
 Geopelia: [Seriously] At least we're both okay, right?
 Saying this, the girl raised her hand and summoned the PhigrOS terminal, ready to store the motorcycle away - until something on the screen caught her eye, and a look of excitement and confusion crossed her face.
 
 
 
 "Gino!"
 "Huh?"
 "Open your terminal and take a look!"

name: Wander and Rest
content:
At a corner of the land stood a lonely three-story cabin. Ivy clung stubbornly to the walls. The floors were staggered, and the exposed rebar connecting them revealed that the building had once been part of a much larger structure.
 "Gino!" Geopelia called from upstairs. "I can't find any backup energy cell in the house. What about your side?"
 "Me neither." Gino wiped his forehead, closed the toolbox that reached his shin, and slid it back to its place against the wall. The motorcycle, Trophon, stood quietly nearby; its heat from overwork not yet faded. "But there are good news - the bike's parts are fine. I think it's just out of energy."
 "Coo. The cabin's power is fine. How about we charge directly from that?"
 "That’s our only choice. Let's try it."
 Gino pulled out the spare cable from the seat compartment, attached an adapter, and plugged it into the power strip Geopelia lowered from upstairs. With a hum, a slowly rising battery indicator appeared on the panel.
 "Yay!"
 The two high-fived through the air.
 
 With that settled, they had nothing left to do. They gathered at the door, thoughts wandering. Geopelia leaned against the doorframe, gazing at the disordered universe. The black hole hung silent overhead - empty at its center, with only its outer ring warped into a glaring orange-red light that is impossible to ignore.
 "Coo-coo, are you too tired to walk?" Gino stepped forward twice, noticed no one following, stopped, and turned to ask.
 "Yeah, a bit." At Gino's words, Geopelia felt weariness rise from the soles of her feet. "How much more do we have to cover, coo..."
 "Not much - just over there." Gino pointed, and as luck would have it, toward the black hole. "Here's the plan: I'll scout ahead. Once the bike is charged, you ride up and follow. Sounds good?"
 "Okay!"

name: [Decipher] About The Universe
content:
All undirected superficial perceptions, mixed together, formed the original Pixel Tower - the prototype of the concept of "world," and a symbol of the "homeland" meme.
Upon it, humanity built a brilliant civilization. They constructed kingdoms of mindsets, which they had never dared to imagine: Glaciaxia, Hoodoo, Neon, Atlas, Haven, et cetera. They built and built, fled and fled, and eventually reached the deepest place of the mind - the Vault.
770 years later, the "Tower" organization had achieved the goal of its simulation. They decided to save the data and shut down the Pixel Tower to prevent technology leakage. And so they activated the Pixel Tower's cleanup protocol - the Mazarine End.
Beneath the all-devouring boundary, the Tower of Babel met its end.

name: [Decipher] About The Universe - Clue II
content: In 2091, as light-based energy resources were running out, Earth - having survived the machine-intelligence crisis, the quantum revolution, and the nuclear energy revolution - was in a little ice age. After decades of war, the survivors moved into a colossal bases beneath the ice, living off the remnants of past civilization and geothermal energy. And in that very year, an unexpected technological explosion was reaching its end.\nThat explosion was the PhigrOS experiment.

name: [Decipher] Evanescent
content:
When exactly did the sky collapse into such a state?

Geopelia sat on the floor, her back against the wooden frame of the tall window. Light escaping from the edge of a distant black hole barely lit half the room, casting a cold, porcelain white over the old objects scattered before her.

Perhaps it was the Tower’s violent collapse that stirred certain memories hidden deep within her consciousness to surface. Geopelia stared at the objects in grim silence. No matter how many times she tried, she could not recall the past of her brother, Peregrinus. She knew the reason why.

In the past, Geopelia had used her memories of “Peregrinus” to create a new “Peregrinus” within the Pixel Tower. But now, said Peregrinus had been corrupted beyond recognition. It’s no longer her dear brother she remembered, but an independent “human”, to the point that she could no longer recognize it, and had even given up on maintaining its existence.

“Where is the real you…”

Geopelia tilted her head to look out the window. The sky was transparent and unfathomable; countless Vaults stretched across like stars forming a galaxy, their light stretched into long, brilliant trails. Invisible long waves occasionally swept past, flickering, breaking, disappearing, repeating in an endless cycle, like a lone swaying boat. The elders said that the longing for a person always fades with time, and only a single fleeting moment remain unforgettably etched in one’s heart. Her only goal now was to simply find that moment, that first and final longing. 
 


 Hint: The dual shadows can’t shake the resolve to leave.

name: [Decipher] Evanescent - Clue I
content:
She saw Gino.
 He had already walked rather far away, as if wading into a stream of pale ink, leaving only a speck of gold flickering in and out of sight. Further away, the grass thinned, revealing a desolate white wasteland shrouded in gray mist. At the very edge of her sight - also the edge of the sky - the ruin of a building slowly took shape. The effort of understanding that sent waves of nausea over Geopelia.
 Her memories of Peregrinus were already shattered, yet somehow, they grew unnaturally clear in that place. But the moment she looked away, that familiarity vanished in an instant.
 Steadying herself, Geopelia dashed down the stairs and jumped onto her motorcycle. The engine’s roar echoed over the Vault, as if the universe itself were trembling along with it.

name: [Decipher] Implexrough
content:
"Do I just hold it, or do I need to do something else?"
 "Theoretically, this thing should activate on its own. Just take it out and hold it. Still, we can't guarantee that it’ll only attract our data. Human brains, you know - getting out cleanly isn't that easy. But it won't be dangerous, at least."
 Gino clutched the replacement data BDRG had given him and kept his head down as he walked. The ground beneath his feet turned from hard to soft. Grayish-white blades of grass brushed against his ankles and gently stroked his calves, growing knee-high, then as tall as a person. They swayed without any wind, fine fuzz falling in clusters, just like the snow he had seen on the surface. He looked back: Geopelia and their cabin were still in sight. Not too far, not too near - just right.
 Only one step remained in His cooperation with BDR: recovering the replacement data BDRG had transmitted earlier, deleting this "virus" from the host's brain, and wipe away the organization's traces. The timing was right. Gino took out the data, letting it emit a blue glow, drawing more of the same from the universe.
 ......
 ......
 ......
 Rustle, rustle.
 Gino stopped. Countless noises gathered around him, multiplying, gradually becoming impossible to ignore. They were formless, rough, and sharp, yet rhythmic enough not to be irritable. Like imprints of flowing thoughts, they shifted endlessly without pause, merely erratically flickering as they wrapped around the drifting replacement data.
 One particularly strange cluser of noise caught Gino's attention. It floated in the air for a long time, and even when Gino approached with the replacement data in hand, its concealed core showed no sign of being drawn in.
 Should he try to untangle it? Gino reached out to touch it.
 
 Hint: Disordered signals heed only disordered choices.

name: [Decipher] Implexrough - Clue I
content:
Before his fingertip could even touch the noise, it noise peeled away from the replacement data, twisted nimbly, and burst open. Bubbles popping, wings buzzing, sparks flying, powder swaying - extraordinary things tangled all together in a chaotic cacophony, yet Gino unexpectedly understood what they meant.
 
 On the night after the earthquake, everyone from the institute was evacuated to an open field. At the two ends of the field, researchers testing radios held this conversation:
 "The universe above us looks like a river of shining stars. Yet, even for light, it takes years to cross the distance between two stars. If human minds are also stars in the universe, then right now, even though we seem to be separated only by this field, your mind remains an uncharted universe I could never reach in my lifetime. I want to change that fact, and for that, I need your strength."
"I’ve told you: once brain-link technology matures, exploitation will shift from labor to the body."
 "It won't. I will prove to you that in a war fought only with minds, free from the constraints of the flesh, victory belongs to no one."
 It was a metaphor about the mind and the universe. Under the effect of redshift, all stars are moving away from one another; similarly, as more people grow, the number of individuals who can truly understand each other grows few. People always say that children are the happiest; their joy is pure, innocent, unstained by the filth of adulthood. I, however, think that a child's happiness stems from "togetherness". Since they are the same, they form a collective consciousness; since they are the same, they believe in joy. At that point, their minds are the closest to one another.

name: Reward
content:
The dim, yellow firelight flickered, radiating an almost illusory warmth. Several tents lay in a deep slumber around the campfire. Their canvases were of various colors, though long faded from use. Snow piled up in their corners and folds, and it was impossible to tell how long they had stood there.
 A small figure sat by the fire, curled up the same manner, a long shadow stretched behind her by the flame.
 "Geopelia!"
 Gino strode out of the meadow to the girl's side. Dropping to one knee, he checked her over from head to toe. Only after confirming she wasn’t hurt did he finally relax.
 "Geo, did you remember something again?"
 Geopelia nodded quietly, letting Gino grasp her wrist and help her up. The layers of her skirt slipped down, revealing the notebook she had been holding tightly against her chest - the sole harvest of her search through the camp.
 "My brother—" Geopelia lowered her eyes, her gaze sweeping across the dark cover before snapping up to meet Gino's. "Has he been here?"
 Her tone was less a question than a conclusion reached after long deliberation. Gino fell silent. There was no need to hide anything now, especially since she already knew everything anyway.
 "Yeah." Gino raised his hand and pointed at a cluster of buildings not far away. "We camped here to rest. And that night, he headed in that direction without telling anyone."
 "Did you go there afterwards, Gino?"
 "No. the higher-ups said nobody was to get close."
 "Geopelia wants to go see."
 She reached out her hand, and he took it. Even if it meant leaving everything behind, she was determined to go.
 
 "Alright, I'll go with you."

name: The Answer
content:
The black hole struck in silence.
 Gino and Geopelia turned and walked toward the motorcycle. Behind them, in the lightless reaches of the universe, the black hole's red ring flared to life, and every star began spinning wildly.
 Rumble! A squall, mixing with snow into a torrent, washed over the grinding crust. Caught off guard by the sudden disaster, the two froze. Gino was the first to realize something was wrong; he grabbed Geopelia's hand, took the lead, and charged forward.
 Gino: Let’s go!
 Geopelia couldn’t open her eyes in the wind. Half-running, half-dragged, she stumbled along. The pages of the notebook in her arms rustled loudly. Weathered by the wind, the aged clasp snapped, and the pages flew away. Geopelia subconsciously followed the pages and looked back.
 Waves crashed - a starry fluid rising higher and higher. The earth shattered, peaks split apart, and falling rocks kicked up clouds of dust.
 Cracks spread rapidly, nearly nipping at Geopelia's heels. Earthquakes reshaped the terrain, and a stream of black water blocked the path between them and their motorcycle. Without a cue, the two leapt one after the other.
 Suddenly, the sky pulled on them both. Before she could land, Geopelia was lifted into the air. Panicked, she flailed - until Gino grabbed the motorcycle with one hand, perilously maintaining his balance.
 Gino: It’s our turn!
 Geopelia: But... But I don't want to be separated from you!
 Gino: It’s time to wake up! Go! [Interrupted]—The black hole will show you the past—isn't that what you wanted to know, Geopelia—Your brother’s whereabouts—Your true self——Only when you leave the Pixel Tower—then every mystery will be solved!
 Geopelia: Then what about you——in reality—will I still be able to find you?
 Gino: [Pause] I'll come find you!
 The moment they let go of each other's hands, an invisible, silent, and colorless force took Geopelia away and engulfed the Sky Dome layer.
 Geopelia watched her little home grow smaller and smaller, finally collapsing into countless points. Then suddenly, the gravity inverted, tearing her free from the Vault's hold. Before she even had the chance to be shocled, she fell into the depths of the universe.

name: Exoplanetary Mirage
content:
In the mid-twenty-first century, the ice age arrived ahead of schedule. While developing the rest of the solar system's terrestrial planets and satellites, humanity also launched five probes to search for a new home. But as exploration proceeded, researchers discovered that exoplanets were nothing more than an astronomical myth. Every known terrestrial planet within a hundred light-years was an illusion produced by errors in a peculiar gravitational-wave theory; every previous observation had been false.

By then, ten years had passed since the probes had launched, and the explorers could not turn back. Some crews had already reached their designated targets. Of course, what they found was not terrestrial planets, but stars that had expanded and collapsed into black holes.

Two years later, another crew accidentally discovered the planet Ca-773 during their voyage. But because of signal interference from its atmosphere, they lost contact with Earth entirely.

In 2089, contact from Ca-773 was received once more. That same year, the first experiment of Project PhigrOS officially began.

name: Peregrinus's Notebook
content: A meticulously protected loose-leaf notebook. Its owner's name is written in the lower-middle area, and both the cover and pages are made of special materials that can withstand any kind of damage.\n\nAfter Peregrinus disappeared, Gino never found this notebook among Peregrinus's belongings.

name: [Decipher] Noise Field
content:
The fall did not last long. Geopelia could feel that the pulling force guiding her was still weakening, and the barrier resisting the surrounding specks of light was growing thinner, disintegrating, and finally engulfing her. Within the formless ocean, Geopelia felt a brief suffocation, only to realize that those specks of light were not causing any actual harm to her.
What is this?
Curiosity was inevitable. Geopelia opened her hand and gently caught one of the beams, letting it flicker and transform in her palm - stretching and flattening, breaking apart and reforming, and then unfurling into a crimson stream of data. It resembled no known coding language. The shift in form reminded her of accessing collections in the terminal, yet it was far too chaotic, too bizarre, too restless and discordant, like noises in a melody. These "noises" were everywhere, barely manipulable, yet Geopelia could never comprehend the information they conveyed, as if they existed merely to act as some sort of obstruction.
Seeing no response coming forth, the "collections" reverted into a tiny, fluctuating speck of light and drifted into the depths of the cosmos. Geopelia withdrew her gaze and looked down at her feet: more specks of light were slowly surging into the vacuum left by the vanished passage, covering it up little by little. There was no time to dwell of it; she had to press through, and quickly.

Hint: ...No. Avoid them. Don't touch them. Don't miss the opportunity because of this. Nothing matters more right now than pushing forward.

name: [Decipher] Forging the Path
content:
The specks of light grew denser. They pressed against one another, interweaving into a tight, net-like structure. The overlapping radiance became dazzling and almost unbearable. Shielding her eyes with the back of her hand, Geopelia forged ahead with difficulty, until all traces of the passage were completely buried, and only a single will in her heart pointed the way forward.
Having stopped who knows how many times, Geopelia felt a rare exhaustion wash over her. Looking back, the black hole - pale and dim, occupying the better part of the firmament - hung like a painting, a shadow, unchanging, serving as the sole reference point in this place. Compared to when she first set out, the size of the black hole had barely changed at all. Geopelia didn't think this meant she was merely treading in place, but these noise-like existences truly slowed down her pace.
Was there any way to manipulate them? Geopelia pondered. If viewed as a riddle, failing to understand the premise didn't preclude searching for consistent elements within it. She began to stir this ocean of signals: whatever stood out, whatever repeated, whatever was anomalous - all could serve as clues, all could hold patterns, all could become opportunities. All it took was - an attempt.

Hint: Collect… and then select and arrange. Will the answer lie within? How would you know unless you try?

name: The Message
content:
It's Geopelia's victory.
With a sweep of the greatsword, a shrill howl burst from the cranial cavity of the hound-like, turbid monster. On its greyish-white shell, cracks spread like roots, widening until they split its entire body, from which dreamy colors began to bleed. In those colors, Geopelia saw her own past - experiences from the Tower, from reality, all slipping by in a fraction of a thought. The illusion of the empty shell shattered, revealing its essence - a turbulence of signals, nearly condensed into solids, piling up into an impassable wall.
Boom.
The sword momentum unspent, she shattered the high wall along with it. Geopelia broke free from the interference of the noises and fell back onto the correct trajectory. She slowly descended onto a vast expanse of open ground, the sensory stimulation gradually fading away.

"Hah-"

The earth was like a mirror, glowing with a soft luminescence; the deep black sky seemed veiled in mist, with occasional patches left uncovered, revealing cybernetic grids. Geopelia raised her head, watching something falling from the sky, and instinctively reached out her hand -

name: Farewell
content:
At the edge of the sky, the Mazarine swallowed up this temporary world.
[The sound of wheels colliding with tracks, the clanking growing louder] [A train whistle wails]
Geopelia stood at the edge of the train platform. A train was approaching from the horizon.
[The sound of steam hissing]
The train pulled into the station and the doors opened. A foot clad in a snow boot stepped onto the platform.
Peregrinus: Geopelia.
Geopelia: [Turns around, surprised, calling out] Brother!
Peregrinus: [Smiling] It’s time for you to go.
Geopelia: [Disappointed] But I've only just found you.
Peregrinus: Separation is but a fleeting moment. Trust me. In the end, people will meet again.
Geopelia: In that world... the one called reality?
Peregrinus: That's right. [The sound of gears turning]
Peregrinus: Your story has only just begun. Go now, and follow where it leads.
A mechanical butterfly took flight and landed gently on Geopelia's hand.
Geopelia fell silent, tears the size of peas welling up in her eyes. She understood now - she would never see her brother again.
Peregrinus: [A radiant smile blooms] Don't cry. Didn't we promise each other?
Peregrinus: No matter what happens, live on, and live well.
Her brother dissolved into tens of thousands of butterflies, streaming away into every direction. The butterfly in Geopelia's palm gave a faint flutter of its wings.

name: The Reality
content:
Geopelia: Liar…

In her room, Geopelia sat on the bed, the mechanical butterfly beside her beating its wings, eager to take flight. An electronic morning paper was spread across the quilt, the headline reading: “Surface Exploration Team Stricken by Severe Earthquake, One Dead, Several Injured.”
A teardrop fell, trembling upon the glossy electronic paper, but the mechanical butterfly flew away. Geopelia hurriedly slipped on her shoes and hurried out the door after it.
She ran out of her bedroom, through the living room, and onto the streets. Once outside, the butterfly had vanished to who-knows-where, leaving only the clamorous hustle of everyday life to crash over her.

Across the land of New Zhengzhou, towering skyscrapers pierced the sky, connecting earth to the heavens. Train tracks converged upon the central station from six sides and fourteen directions, running day and night.
Trains connected countless stories. Geopelia thought to herself, would there brother's story be among them?

Geopelia: …

????: Excuse me…
A familiar voice rang in her ear, pulling Geopelia back to reality.
Gino: Is this yours?

The butterfly squeezed its way out just before the two of them drew close, fluttering leisurely into the distance. A flock of white pigeons beat their wings and soared upward, sweeping past the camera, flying higher and ever higher.

name: Stave No.7
Stave No.8
content:
Child of Hoodoo, why don't you go home?

 
Hoodoo, oh, Hoodoo,
My hometown that haunts my mind.
Here runs the shining river,
Here lives the glorious past.
Drumbeat is its theme,
Joy is its promise.

There are
Peristele splashed by oil paints
Towering over all the seas
There are
Wildman with disheveled hair
Singing freely

Electromagnetic rail inlaid with bricks flaring like bright sun
Remainings of machinery fly slowly without insturction
That is the fortune as if from heaven
Holding the last hope

By now my elder generations
Frocks taken off
Guarding the fortune bitterly
Like salt statues.

I know they are perishing.
Human can not reside over trash,
So is the world

name: Stave No.9
content:
Acknowledgement cannot change destiny
Once truth neighbored with fiction
Truth honored fiction with the superior manner
Fiction refused and took the inferior contrary
Thence the two never met yet in the same room
Both know the other, yet hold their tongues

name: [Merch] Judgement Line Pillow
content: Soft, and squishy~\nA piece of merchandise that still hasn't seen mass production.

name: Ancient Flute - Clue I
content: Gino received a clue from 115. After opening it, he was faced with the revelation that the elements of the flute resemble parts of the Tower.

name: [Item] Sheriff's Badge
content: Outdated work credential of Sheriff Gino. Gino's appearance on the ID is far more child-like than how he is now.

name: [Image] Tower
content: An illustration strip hangs on the wall of an establishment called "The Pigeon Bar". It depicted a gigantic, upside-down tower.\nAccording to the owner, it was painted by his subordinate, Ms. Sakura. She insists that the picture is hung correctly.

name: [Image] Site Inspection Record
content:
Confirming identification of well-known female singer, stage name of Zuo.
[Contains sensitive content, viewer discretion is advised]

The victim's head has been gnawed on beyond recognition, presumably by rats. The subject's bodily fluids and the sewage from dark alley behind the venue mixed into a dirty, dark, viscous red stream. Keratin filaments were floating on the surface water; the sewage dyed a gradient of colours on the subject's clothing, attracting critters, pecking away at the ilusory rainbow. The scene was filled with a raw scent of viscera and decomposition, however it also had a tinge of sweetness. The wells don't have changing seasons, and this one is rather warm, due to it's closeness to the planet's core. If she was left unattended, stems and leaves would have grown out of her soul and flesh, sucking up the rest of her once living body, swaying in the stagnant air.

name: [Item] Winter Star Fragment
content: A mysterious, icy stone picked up by Geopelia when passing through the light gate. A synthesis of snow and stars, it seems to be calling out to her.

name: [item] Radio
content: A radio that Kuzumi asked Fuli to repair. It appears to be the same model as the one Geopelia got as a kid.

name: Radio - Clue I
content: The juvenile's hands were covered in grease. He took out a brand new radio from his waist pack, and handed it to his little sister.\n'Happy birthday, Geopelia.'

name: Radio - Clue II
content:
Fuli: Ugh... Nothing...
Geopelia: Are you having trouble?
Fuli: Actually I still haven't even figured out where the defect is...
Geopelia: Can I have a look?
Fuli: Euh...  [losing hope]
[Geopelia started fiddling with the radio's main board. She remembered her brother telling her: "Radios of this brand have a weak spot in design. See? Right here. If it ever breaks, you will need to re-solder that spot. After that it shouldn't break anymore. If you do it well enough, it might even start working better than other radios."]
Geopelia: How about you try welding this spot?
Fuli: Eh, sure I guess? [Unconvinced, she did what the girl instructed, as she can just unsolder it later.]
Fuli: It actually worked! I can't believe it! You are amazing, Geo!
Geopelia: Haha, always at your service, ma'am!
[After that visit, the memories of her past, and of her brother, started to reemerge from time to time. But no matter how hard she tried, she could not recall her brother's appearance. She knows where she came from, and how she ended up here.]

name: [Rec] Drums of Peace
content:
[Geopelia and Gino heard a strange tune, and decided to track down its source. The music led them to the rubbish mountain. Before them laid countless electronic devices, dropped to the peak by a magnetic track. Standing by the foot of the mountain, Geopelia noticed a few scavengers each beating their drum, chanting words nobody could understand.]
[Suddenly, a giant piece of machinery fell from the peak, landing right on top of the scavengers. But somehow, the music didn't stop. Perhaps, the rubbish around them broke its fall before it could hit them.]
[Gino rushed to help them. Each footstep he took on the uneven footing sounded as if it was part of the song. The more intense the scavengers' drum beats were, the faster Gino jumped and ran. After he reached them, he dragged a nearby I-beam to the site and pivoted the machinery, entrapping the still drumming scavengers. By the time Geopelia arrived at the scene, peeking from behind her butterfly ornament, Gino had finished halfway.]
Gino: You cuckoo, don't just stand there and watch!
Geopelia: I believe that Gino possesses such great strength, that even without the cuckoo, he will still accomplish this feat with ease. [Geopelia, opened Alpa, sat down in a corner on some leather, snickering at Gino, who was drenched in sweat.]
Gino: Then why did you even come here!
Geopelia: To fulfil my task from the Coo-coo organisation and hear out the voice of the working class, of course!
[The scavengers put down their drums, turned to the newly arrived Geopelia, who started a casual conversation with them. After a while, the scavengers took a liking to the girl, almost forgetting about the man who saved them. If he didn't consider her family, Gino would have probably been blinded with jealousy.]
Gino: Sigh...

name: [Item] Magic Wand
