name: Bernice's Research Notes - Clue I
content:
January 32nd: 
The meaning of history varies from person to person. 
In terms of the authenticity, the history known to people now and the fictional story are interestingly equivalent, as both being the ramblings of other people. Even if the narrator recounts the details fully, the reality after mixed with opinions will deform to a certain extend. 
So how should the real history be discovered and how should it be passed on? Words and records are ultimately pale. Only objects from the past can allow those who come later to peek into the trail left by the truth in time. 
Can we claim that the past in words has no meaning? No either. By comparing multiple stories and filtering them through each other, we can obtain a purer history. And the conclusion I made with this method is that, Lotos was not destroyed; it still exists, somewhere at the bottom of the Endless Sea.

name: Bernice's Research Notes - Clue II
content:
At that time, Ida walked into my office, filled with the dusty light in front of me. Through files slanted by the window scattered on the floor, I could see the impatience in her eyes. She probably has sensed something. We come from that Itaca family that is obsessed with natural production. Fortunately, Ida is a Limbo and not qualified to contact the core of the family. Ida's mother left when she was still very young, so it was always me who took care of her. 
Ida: "You and Erapeter are still in touch?" 
Bernice: "He's been funding my research, and you know how costly it is on data to do research." 
Ida: "That kind of snakehead ...... whatever, forget it." 
Bernice: "No resource is noble or humble. " 
Ida: "Are You going to fool me round with historical allusions again?" 
Bernice: "We are the creation of God, and everything we accomplish is in praise of God. This is someone who did all the evil, but also funded many artists in the old days." 
Ida: "It sounds like his praise also included the evil deeds." 
Bernice: "By the way, if Lotos is found, do you want to come with me?" 
Ida: "It will be banned. None of it is good." 
Bernice: "I thought you'd be curious." 
Ida: "Let history return to history. That's what you said."

name: Bernice's Research Notes - Clue III
content:
Ida: "Are you leaving because of the poem in the box?" 
Bernice: "Yes, to Port Odysseus. They seem to want to meet at the Endless Sea." 
Ida: "I should go. After all, I'm the one asking the questions." 
Bernice: "Changed your mind?" 
Ida: "Just thinking, about going out for a walk." 
Ida: "There's a voice keeps telling me not to go, that Bernice is lying to you, and there is no such thing as Lotos. If Lotos is so illusory, then what is it that you all are seeking. That’s all I want to know."

name: Bernice's Magical Satchel
content: A satchel that no one would be surprised to see. It can be bought in any store. Interestingly, though Bernice often loses things, only those put into the satchel remain intact. Or perhaps as it was a gift from a deceased person, it makes it an item that Bernice keeps to this day.

name: Bernice's Magical Satchel - Clue I
content:
After landing safely in Lotos, Ida was a little overwhelmed to see Sappho and Mentus lost conscious. While Bernice, at the moment she saw Lotos, recalled the sealed memory of what is called "the wisdom of all-knowing", one of the five souls of Cronos.
Sure enough. Bernice smiled and reassured to Ida, "It's going to be all right. Their conscious is still in cache. They'll wake up."
"Bernice? You … seems to be a little different." 
"Take them to the Miracle Forest. "
"What about you?" 
"I need to go to the control centre. I have to."

name: Bernice's Magical Satchel - Clue II
content:
Moving two bodies was not easy. Ida luckily found a cart that still worked. On her way to the depths, she noticed a fresh trail of footprints, and following it, she found the well without any problems. After putting the body in place, Ida noticed that the trail continued. 
Could this be, Erapeter's footprint? 
What was he trying to do? Ida couldn't contain her curiosity and began to follow the tracks. 
Ida followed the tracks to the control centre. Her mind went blank when she saw Bernice, fallen to the side. 
Erapeter did not notice Ida's intrusion. At this time, he had already used the Box of Delusion and reversed the energy pathway. It would not take long before Lotos to surface and reappear in the world. 
I did it. Erapeter, no, the “desire of reappearing" laughed wildly, with the two souls he already had in his hands, and the "clue of returning" obtained from Mentus, plus the "wisdom of all-knowing ", the core of Lotos, finally opened for him.

name: Bernice's Magical Satchel - Clue III
content:
Bernice's severe injury made Ida lose her mind, and her soul cried out in pain. Ida took out her pocketknife and stabbed towards Erapeter recklessly. He reacted in time, dodged sideways and seized the weapon.
Erapeter was surprised by the appearance of Ida. One without soul should not appear in Lotos. 
"You shouldn't be here, unless." 
Erapeter had a bold idea, but it was impossible. 
"It seems you know." 
Waking up, Bernice pulled her pistol out of her bag, pulled the trigger, and Erapeter lost all signs of life. 
"Body deactivation detected. Body regeneration required." 
"We will collect only partial death information, then initiate the program for you." 
"Floating point error. Activation program terminated. Thank you for using PhigrOS. May we meet again in the future. 
Bernice hugged Ida tightly and softly whispered: 
"It's over." 
"Yeah, it's all over. You shouldn't have come back, Bernice." 
Ida is no longer who she is now, but the past and the future merged into one. The shackles that seal Lotos have been broken. The waves of the Endless Sea will engulf the city. The monsters that once overthrown Lavabo will come for a second time. And within seven days, Atlas will be destroyed again. This time, there is no coming back. 
"Let's go. When it wakes up, it will be too late." 
Ida pressed the teleportation button, and Bernice disappeared before she could do anything. 
Sitting by the piano, Ida held up the keys and played a distant melody, as if the bell of doom rings a deafening shot at the fake calm. Something is about to happen. Fish acted like a tornado of storms, fleeing to leave the area of Lotos for their lives, followed by the protective circle. The pitch-black whims climbed up the outer wall sucking energy, and soon rendering the protective circle useless. The sea gushed into this paradise, and all where it passes were only left with debris. Lotos is collapsing. In a short moment, the control centre will also be gone. 
"What a nice dream, don't you think, Bernice." 
Her eyes glowed with sorrow. She would not want to wake up, if she could.

name: Sappho's Action Camera

It was a gift that Sappho's guardian bought from a small workshop for her, out of kindness and knowledge of her when they parted way. \nBut that's not what Sappho liked about this camera. The camera's private album does not show up in the album list like others, but only after taking three consecutive photos at a specific angle, which is extremely secure. The camera's private album holds several photos of Ida, all marked with the location where they were taken.

name: Sappho's Action Camera - Clue I
content:
Ida: Sappho? 
Sappho: Yo, it's been a long time. 
Ida: Long time no see. Can't seem to find you lately. 
Sappho: I was just busy with work. How did you get to the Endless Sea? I thought this is a black dock. 
Ida: I made an appointment with someone. Initially I was coming with my cousin together, but I don't know where she went to after receiving a phone call. 
Sappho: All right. 
Ida: You want to come with me? It's always better with one more pair of helping hands.

name: Sappho's Action Camera - Clue II
content:
Sappho: Ever since I was born, I didn't know what I should do, so I just did a lot of things I liked. Always go to the places I like, see the scenery I like, and love the people I like. 
Ida: That's nice. 
Sappho: But is it freedom? Or is it just wandering all the time because you don't know where your roots are. 
Ida: That's fine for you, Sappho. Why should people avoid what they like.
Sappho: So why are you avoiding Lotos? 
Ida: Bernice talks to you about anything. Well, that place was important to me in my last life, but I can't remember the past. For now, I'm just me.
Sappho: That said, you should go, Bernice is right, you only have one chance.

content:

-- This is a Botticelli III! The best action camera of that era! 
-- I didn't know there was a third generation. 
-- Yea, you have no idea, right? After the second generation was developed, their boss Clear was scam into bankruptcy by the Animitta Group, and everyone thought there wouldn't be a third generation. But in fact, the design blueprint was already completed by designer Samuelle. 
--That person, I remember Clear and Samuelle ran the Clock Link Rally after they made a comeback again. 
--That's them! The third-generation design blueprint could not be put into production, so Samuelle sold them to a small collective. But this collective also soon went out of business, and the third generation only made less than a hundred final products. Coupled with quality control issues many were not even functional. Even collectors who bought them thought it to be a mock-up by some small workshop, and treat the third generation to be simply never existed. Well, didn't expect seeing the real thing today. 
-- Careful. The person who commissioned to salvage is the owner of the camera. It needs to be sent back. 
-- Why, why would this be ......

name: Directional Rope
content:
Instruction manual: 
Note: This product should be used with subspace beacon conforming to specification KN-12. Unexpected errors may occur when using old specification beacons. 
The automatic mode can be adjusted by adjusting the knobs of any section of the rope. 
Do not use third-party software to alter the three pre-set modes of this product. Unexpected problems may occur.

The driver can also be used to remotely control the power end of the rope.

name: Directional Rope - Clue I
content:
Sappho and Ida followed the locator to an ordinary residential building. Mentus was in the room on the topmost floor. 
The two arrived at the roof. Sappho reached down with the camera she carried to capture the inside of the house. There were no guards, and Mentus was the only one blindfolded and tied to a stool. The two girls entered the room through the open window and untied Mentus. Ida pulled out Pallas' ID, and questioned Mentus. 
Ida: "Why do you have this?" 
Mentus: "He's my father." 
Mentus roughly remembered Ida, who is Limbo, who is not allow to access family secrets. Ida felt Mentus looked familiar, but couldn't quite remember; the Itaca family shouldn't be present in the Pixel Tower, and the near-crazy bloodline worship made her sick. Sappho could see her buddy's embarrassment, and continued to ask for her. 
Sappho: "Father? Then how come you're not an Itaca?" 
Mentus: "Hm, I used the name Itaca before as well, but then I was traced by these people because of Lotos. Therefore, I left the harbour and changed to a new name as well." 
Sappho: "Why did they track you down?" 
Mentus: "That is, of course, I have something they want."

name: Directional Rope - Clue II
content:
After making the deal with Erapeter, Ida and Sappho arrived at the port early and hid under the "port exit". 
Several men in black escorted Mentus, accompanied by Erapeter. He took the compass from Mentus’ diving suit, turned it twice to target the "bottom of the sea", took out the Box of Delusion gotten from Bernice, and was about to merge it with the Pearl of Truth. 
Not far away, had put on the equipment, Bernice threw out the directional rope, directly rushed downwards. With one hand she grabbed Mentus’ strap, while taking away the Box of Delusion. The man in black looked in the direction Bernice appeared, but accidentally found the Ida and Sappho in the corner, and pulled the alarm. 
Seeing that things went wrong, Sav took the beacon and prepares to go down. But Ida hesitantly stopped. 
"When Mentus was captured, didn't we agree to go together to save him?" 
"I …" 
Ida hesitated for a moment. As she remembered Bernice's worried look, she hugged Sappho tightly once again. 
"Let's go."

name: Identification
content:
The old ID card, with void recording function. It was no longer produced after people left Lotos and was replaced by an implanted electronic ID. 
Only the name of the owner is printed on the surface. The rest of the information are stored in the internal chip. 
Though severely worn, the name written on it is still recognizable. 
Pallas Itaca.

name: Identification - Clue I
content:
Ida: This place is okay, right? 
Sappho: They shouldn't be able to come in. Let's see if we lost anything, and later we'll go out to the Ruling Bureau to report the black port. 
Ida: What's that in your pocket? 
Sappho: It seems to be something dropped by that guy, let me see, Pallas ...... 
Ida: Pallas Itaca. 
Sappho: Didn't he not use his real name just now?
Ida: Not necessarily, Pallas was the founder of the Itaca family, and was reborn a long time ago. 
Sappho: Let's go find him and get to the bottom of this. 
Ida: How? Port Odysseus is so big. 
Sappho: I put a tracker on him. 
Ida: When? 
Sappho: It’s a secret.

name: Identification - Clue II
content:
Mentus: You believe that story for the kids? 
Erapeter: You have no room for bargaining. It seems that before you talk, these two will have to suffer as well. 
Ida: Wait, Erapeter? 
Erapeter: No wonder you look familiar. You're Bernice's sister, right? 
Ida: Yea, it's me. We can make a deal. You want to go to Lotos, right? This guy knows how to get there, and the answer is on this piece of paper. We give you the paper, and you let us go. 
Erapeter: Put the Pearl of Truth into the Box of Delusion, and the door to the Promissory will open itself. It's that simple? 
Ida: It's that simple. I'm sure you roughly already know about it. He showed me that he had the things on him. 
Erapeter: Indeed. but you still know too little. 
Ida: What? 
Erapeter: You two go, for Bernice's sake.

name: Identification - Clue III
content:
After Sappho and Mentus got separated from the other two, they explored the empty streets of Lotos, and soon the obstacle on the ground attracted Sappho's attention. 
It was a cold corpse. Stiff limbs, no external injuries all over the body, eyes normally closed, as if it had died in its sleep. The place was spooky everywhere, the debris after the evacuation, the corpse that never decayed, and that familiar face. 
Sappho realized something and turned to look behind at Mentus, only to see him kneel down slowly in front of the corpse, eventually kneeling on the ground, hugged the body and started crying silently. 
Sappho: "Who the hell are you?"
Holding the corpse, he did not respond to Sappho. But Sappho realised, that it was a dream and they had to wake up. 
But, after waking up, where should she go. 
Fear filled Sappho's mind. Why would she have this thought.

name: Pearl of Truth
content:
All truth, is nothing more than a mixture of fiction and reality. 
Reality is a direction, but never a norm. 
When you meet the fiction, do not forget it. 
Wake up from the dream of the past.

name: Pearl of Truth - Clue I
content: The items of the Rhythm Star are woven by music. Those who live in this layer are constantly nourished by music, making the happiness here significantly higher than in other layers. But these melodies are not perfect. Not because they are not beautiful enough, but because a very noticeable break at the beginning and at the end of each cycle. \nWhen Mentus first found the Pearl of Truth from his father's safe, he found nothing special about the ball, but only an unusual attraction. Later he discovered that the Pearl of Truth was not like other things. It always carries a intermittent noise with eerie ups and downs. Its rhythm is perfect, and beyond imagination.

name: Pearl of Truth - Clue II
content:
[Ida and Sappho arrived at the restaurant they reserved and were about to sit down.] 
Waiter: I am sorry. This seat has a reservation. 
Ida: We're the ones who made the reservation here. 
Waiter: May I ask for the name of the reservation? 
Ida: Mentus. Mentus Petman. 
Waiter: Sorry, that doesn't match the names we have on record. I can't let you two use the place. 
Sappho: Look, the person who reserved here isn't here anyway, so we'll just sit here until he arrives. And if it's not the person we want to see, then we'll leave right away. 
Waiter: I'm afraid that's not appropriate. 
Sappho: There should be a time limit on reservations, right? I know the reservation time is six o'clock sharp, so if he doesn't show up in eighteen minutes, the reservation will be automatically voided, and we'll just leave. 
Waiter: All right then, I'll come back when all the guests are here. 
[Ten minutes later, they unexpectedly received a package. The two had their guess, and before they could open it, a familiar figure walked into the restaurant. But when Ida saw the face of the person, she withdrew her guess. 】 
Mentus: Thanks for waiting. So let's get started.

name: Wiretap
content: It appears to be a square grey card with a case that can change colour to blend into different environments. It can scan the surrounding environment with sonar, and roughly restore the space around its location with very low pixels. Although it sees no colour, it is sufficient to distinguish the movements of people. For example, it can check whether the subject is communicating with a pen and paper.
